mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM t_masseur m JOIN masseur_project mp ON mp.masseur_id = m.id AND mp.deleted = 0 JOIN t_project p ON p.id = mp.project_id AND p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE m.store_id = #{storeId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.rating DESC
